## Session handoff — the change MERGED but the ticket is not closeable as-is

State at handoff: `in_progress`. **Gerrit 1920 merged as `721cb7d6ac`** (verified: one commit on
`origin/main` carries this ticket's trailer). A `plan-review` attestation is present; there is no
completion attestation.

**Blocker: 0 of 12 ACs are ticked**, and I am deliberately not ticking them. This session did not
run this ticket's work and has not verified its criteria; ticking boxes on someone else's
unverified work is the failure mode the close gate exists to prevent. Several of these ACs name
specific verification commands (AC1-AC7 are structural assertions about where symbols live and
what imports them; AC8-AC12 are gate invocations) and each needs to be run and observed, not
assumed from a green CI.

**What the next session should do:** work the AC list against the merged commit `721cb7d6ac` —
most are cheap, being greps and gate runs — tick each one you actually verify, then close through
the completion verifier. If any AC turns out to be **falsified** rather than met, record the
divergence in a comment and do NOT reword the AC: an AC-prose edit stales the plan-review
attestation and forces a full `review-plan` re-run before the close will succeed. That happened
twice in this session; a checkbox tick is attestation-safe, prose is not.

Note the gate comment above already records AC8 (`make lint`) and AC9 (`make typecheck`) as PASS
for patch set 1 — that is evidence toward those two, though it predates the merged revision.
